notes.kicker: note - how these renders were produced
body: A widget-test harness (test/render/render_screen_test.dart); no app code touched. It wraps the real SticksShell in agent_sdk's SticksScope and SticksPage - the same host the installed sticks_pages.dart uses - and renders it at 390 logical px (dpr 3) at the full content height.

The data is the SDKs' own demo data. StickRepository reads the api.sticks.* cmds through the platform gateway; base_sdk's DemoGatewayInterceptor answers them from agent_sdk's fixtures (assets/demo/sticks).
Real fonts: Inter and Montserrat are the genuine files Google serves, committed under test/render/fonts/ and verified by google_fonts' own length and SHA-256 check.

notes.kicker: what these frames deliberately do NOT show
body: The stick rows are the demo fixture team. Their navigation is a no-op in the harness, so no sub-page is captured; the strip shows the team page only.
The brand palette is not applied in this harness, so colours are the AppStyle defaults.
